pages.name: Grass-Fed Collagen Peptides
pages.seoTitle: Grass-Fed Collagen Peptides Powder, Unflavored | Zeotein
pages.seoDescription: Collagen peptides from grass-fed cattle, 11g protein per serving. Dissolves clear in hot or cold drinks. 1/2 lb, 1 lb and 2 lb pouches.

vars.s_intro: Collagen peptides from grass-fed cattle. Unflavored, and it dissolves clear into hot or cold drinks, coffee included.
vars.s_how: Mix 2 tablespoons (12.5 g) into 8 to 12 oz of water, milk, coffee, tea or a smoothie. Hot or cold both work. Also works in yogurt, oatmeal and baking.
vars.s_bag: Grass-fed bovine collagen peptides. That's the whole list.

pages.name: Grass-Fed Bone Broth Protein
pages.seoTitle: Grass-Fed Bone Broth Protein Powder, Unflavored | Zeotein
pages.seoDescription: Grass-fed beef bone broth protein powder, 15g protein per serving. Mild and unflavored for coffee, soup or a smoothie. 1/2 lb to 2 lb pouches.

vars.s_alt: Zeotein Grass-Fed Bone Broth Protein pouch
vars.s_intro: Grass-fed beef bone broth, dried into a fine powder. Mild and unflavored, so it goes into coffee, soup, oatmeal or a smoothie.
vars.s_how: Mix 3 tablespoons (16 g) into 8 to 12 oz of water, milk, coffee, tea or a smoothie. Hot or cold both work. Also works stirred into soup, broth and sauces.
vars.s_bag: Grass-fed beef bone broth protein. That's the whole list.

pages.name: Organic Hemp Protein
pages.seoDescription: Organic hemp protein, 14g protein and 6g fiber per serving. Naturally nutty, and the same hemp protein in Zeotein Vegan. 1/2 lb to 2 lb pouches.

vars.s_intro: Hemp seeds, cold-pressed and milled. Naturally nutty and earthy, and the same hemp protein in Zeotein Vegan.
vars.s_how: Mix 1/4 cup (28 g) into 8 to 12 oz of water, milk, coffee, tea or a smoothie. Hot or cold both work. Hemp stays slightly grainy, so shake it or blend it.
vars.s_bag: Organic hemp protein powder. That's the whole list.

pages.name: Organic Pumpkin Seed Protein
pages.seoTitle: Organic Styrian Pumpkin Seed Protein Powder | Zeotein
pages.seoDescription: Organic Styrian pumpkin seed protein, 11g protein per serving. Mild and nutty, and the same pumpkin seed protein in Zeotein Vegan.

vars.s_alt: Zeotein Organic Pumpkin Seed Protein pouch
vars.s_intro: Austrian-grown Styrian pumpkin seeds, cold-pressed and milled into a plant protein powder. Mild and nutty, and the same pumpkin seed protein in Zeotein Vegan.
vars.s_how: Mix 2 tablespoons (17 g) into 8 to 12 oz of water, milk, coffee, tea or a smoothie. Hot or cold both work. It stays slightly grainy, so shake it or blend it.
vars.s_bag: Organic Styrian pumpkin seed protein powder, sea salt (less than 1%). That's the whole list.

pages.name: Organic Fermented Cacao Powder
pages.seoTitle: Organic Fermented Cacao Powder, Unsweetened | Zeotein
pages.seoDescription: Raw, fermented organic cacao with a deep dark chocolate taste, the same cacao in Zeotein Cacao. Swap it 1:1 for cocoa powder.

vars.s_alt: Zeotein Organic Fermented Cacao Powder pouch
vars.s_intro: Natural process cacao with a deep dark chocolate taste. Use it 1:1 anywhere you use cocoa powder: shakes, coffee, oatmeal and baking. It is the same cacao in Zeotein Cacao.
vars.s_how: Mix 1 tablespoon (6 g) into 8 to 12 oz of water, milk, coffee, tea or a smoothie. Hot or cold both work. In recipes, swap it 1:1 for cocoa powder.
vars.s_bag: Organic fermented cacao powder. That's the whole list.

pages.name: Organic MCT Oil Powder
pages.seoTitle: Organic MCT Oil Powder, Unflavored | Zeotein
pages.seoDescription: MCT oil from coconut in an easy powder that mixes into coffee, shakes and smoothies. 1/2 lb, 1 lb and 2 lb pouches.

vars.s_alt: Zeotein Organic MCT Oil Powder pouch
vars.s_intro: MCT oil from coconut in an easy powder. It mixes into coffee, shakes and smoothies, and it froths in coffee.
vars.s_how: Mix 1 1/2 tablespoons (10 g) into 8 to 12 oz of water, milk, coffee, tea or a smoothie. Hot or cold both work. If MCTs are new to you, start with half a serving.
vars.s_bag: Organic MCT oil powder (organic coconut MCT oil, organic gum acacia, silicon dioxide). That's the whole list.

pages.name: Organic Sea Moss Powder
pages.seoTitle: Organic Sea Moss Powder, Wildcrafted in St. Lucia | Zeotein
pages.seoDescription: Wildcrafted organic sea moss from St. Lucia, 75% gold and 25% purple, finely milled. A mild taste that disappears in a fruit smoothie.

vars.s_alt: Zeotein Organic Sea Moss Powder pouch
vars.s_head: Wildcrafted in St. Lucia. 75% gold, 25% purple.
vars.s_intro: Finely milled, with a mild ocean taste that disappears in a fruit smoothie.
vars.s_how: Mix 1 teaspoon (3.4 g) into 8 to 12 oz of water, milk, coffee, tea or a smoothie. Hot or cold both work. Sea moss thickens liquid slightly, more in hot than cold, so it also works in soups and sauces.
vars.s_bag: Organic sea moss (Gracilaria spp.), wildcrafted, 75% gold and 25% purple. That's the whole list.
vars.s_note: If you are pregnant or nursing, have a medical condition, or take medication, talk to your healthcare provider before using a sea moss product.

pages.name: Organic Lion's Mane Powder
pages.seoTitle: Organic Lion's Mane Mushroom Powder, Unflavored | Zeotein
pages.seoDescription: Organic lion's mane mushroom powder, finely milled, 1,400 mg per serving. Mild and earthy, and it disappears into coffee.

vars.s_alt: Zeotein Organic Lion's Mane Powder pouch
vars.s_intro: Organic lion's mane mushroom (Hericium erinaceus), finely milled. Mild and earthy, and it disappears into coffee.
vars.s_how: Mix 1/2 teaspoon (1.4 g) into 8 to 12 oz of water, milk, coffee, tea or a smoothie. Hot or cold both work. Also works in broth and oatmeal.
vars.s_bag: Organic lion's mane mushroom powder (Hericium erinaceus, mycelium). That's the whole list.

_images: Packaging photos are never cropped (Dana's standing rule). Product photos are each product's FIRST image on zeotein.com (Dana, 11 Nov): the bag for Cacao, the stick-pack shot for Vegan, the pouch for each single-ingredient powder. No scoop shots. Where a label prints ZEOLITE, IMMUNE, DETOX or INFLAMMATION (Cacao bag, Vegan stick packs, including the small print on each stick) those words are garbled by reordering the label's own letters; the files live in Shopify Files (uploaded 11 Nov 2026) and pass the OCR gate at full size and 640px. The single-ingredient pouches print none of those words and are used as published on zeotein.com. The Zeolite Powder is left off this site: the house rules never name the mineral and its pouch name is the word itself.
